notes.title: Taking Out The Trash - Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/8afd068b2737314dd939ebbf1d8ae8c9c90d93fa.png[/img]

[h3][b]First, a thank you![/b][/h3]

Thanks so much to all our fans and players out there who played Trash’s early [b]Public Alpha Demo[/b] and gave us such helpful and wonderful feedback! After the release of [b]Trash’s Holiday Update[/b], we took a brief dev holiday ourselves in order to refresh our wasted brains (our creative director was starting to wonder whether he was in fact himself, a trash based life form). Since returning we have spent a number of months looking over all the feedback and finding ways we can improve the demo before we move towards our next stage of development. 

[h3][b]What is this trash all about?[/b][/h3]

[b]The Taking Out The Trash Update[/b] isn’t a content update, rather a chance for us to add the things you asked for and make Trash easier to pick up and play! The update aims to improve player experience and give you your friends a funner, trashier time! As always the demo can be played either solo or cooperatively online with up to 3 friends!

[h3][b]A Rubbish List of Changes[/b][/h3]

[b]UI[/b]
[*] New player objective system
[*] New Resource pickup notifications
[*] New ingame directional signs 
[*] New player interactions
[*] Improved UI visuals & designs
[*] Improved & simplified  ingame language
[*] Updated Splash Screens & Menu Layout

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/f4834535897047b80fc158263712cb37640e80bc.gif[/img]

[b]Player Character[/b]
[*] New player form VFX
[*] New player resource pickups zones
[*] New player form use opportunities
[*] Improved player interaction mechanics
[*] Improved player camera mechanics
[*] Improved player movement and jump mechanics

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/79d254e4958df6367e62f9a305f85989aae8947d.gif[/img]

[b]Cinematics[/b]
[*] New internal Challenge Zone cinematic cameras 
[*] New external Challenge Zone cinematic cameras
[*] New game progression cinematic cameras
[*] Improved cinematic demo ending

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/fe654818e093a69c11d616d04a03dccb29bf588e.gif[/img]

[b]Environment[/b]
[*] Improved object & environment colliders
[*] Improved player start zone
[*] Improved resource VFX
[*] Improved Challenge Zone visuals and decals

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/32ce2e2af6dc507ae8d4c88f33a64019a0594437.gif[/img]

[b]Optimisation[/b]
[*] New Flora LOD system
[*] New graphics and resolution settings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/4fea9cb0bb5ada8178a863ac812ebd96a9e3328d.gif[/img]

[b]Audio[/b]
[*] Objective complete fanfare 
[*] Audio zones for environmental VFX



[h3]We appreciate your support & hope you find the time to give Trash a play! If you do, you can give us feedback here:[/h3]

[url=https://twitter.com/15MinutesOfGame]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://forms.gle/DNLSHqA3FQ3BJQ4e6]Feedback Form[/url]
or in our community page!

[h3]Have a rubbish day! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/e3a301374c532bb0ad7c6e2eede18625d8802965.jpg[/img]

[h3]And now, a massive list of fixed bugs![/h3]

[b]Resources Bugs[/b]

[*] Client: Challenge Zone resource collection error ResourceManager.DestroyResourceObject
[*] Client: pickup resource incorrect tally in UI
[*] Client: picking up resource while host is in menu (in-game) doesn’t update inventory counts
[*] Client: pickup resources count 0
[*] Resources duplicating when returning to open world
[*] Some resource sites spawn too high (scrap metal, resin, tape)


[b]UI Bugs[/b]

[*] Camera adjustments
[*] Control sensitivity broaden & add y-axis UI
[*] Remove player HUD resin counter
[*] Host 'failed to load' on open load game UI. Didn't prevent loading game
[*] Chat creates null error when closed & other player sends message
[*] Chat text colour markup
[*] Chat - clients can't see their own messages
[*] Hunt CE causing client to d/c on load
[*] Client loses mouse on main menu when kicked by host
[*] Client hangs on load screen when trying to join Host in CZ
[*] Join CZ0 - client loading UI doesn’t disable
[*] UI scale for 4:3, 5:3, 16:9, 16:10
[*] Interact UI doesn't disappear for non-interacting client
[*] Inventory UI Resource UI updating pickup count instead of totals
[*] Inventory UI Client resource counts not updating when entering game
[*] Remote client loading into open world after leaving CZ still has CZ menu

[b]Challenge Zones (CZ's) Bugs[/b]

[*] CZ6 state 2 triggers when CZ5 completed
[*] CZ6 ending cinematic run order
[*] CZ3 end zone is available before pulling lever (oil ending)
[*] CZ Oil ending trigger can be activated & ending state 2 audio can still be heard for other players
[*] CZ0 returns to state 1 after completing CZ for the 2nd time
[*] CZ1 timer doesn’t reset from CZ0 time
[*] Client doesn't get CZ0 cinematic camera when completing CZ0
[*] When client loads in, CZ0 in state 1 - should be state 2
[*] CZ prevent 2 HuntCE in a row

[b]Challenge Elements Bugs[/b]

[*] Hunt removing object from slot causes slot data to be reset
[*] CZ1 - client disconnected when host picked up Hunt pickup
[*] Increase VFX size on resources & hunt components

[b]Open World Bugs[/b]

[*] Breakable wall at CZ2 isn’t breakable
[*] Megamite proximity not triggering for client
[*] Added Pipe fast travel interact

[b]Open World Bugs[/b]

[*] Deformer not displaying ‘in store’ or ‘in use’ numbers for client
[*] Crafter not displaying inventory resources properly after crafting
[*] Clearer descriptions in crafter and deformer
[*] Disconnect null error When a player is using crafter and another player picks up a resource

[b]Player Character Bugs[/b]

[*] Glide Form: recalibration 
[*] Boulder Form: player does not reappear
[*] Player interact rework
[*] Jump power recalibration 
[*] Client pickup hunt parts incorrectly aligned in body
[*] Reduce player movement - sprint & walk
[*] Picking up items - reduce distance & narrow target

[b]Networking Bugs[/b]
[*] Host/Client disconnect sync
[*] Spawn scene object error on client join new game OR change scene

[b]Audio Bugs[/b]
Quitting from CZ end zone - music doesn’t reset
Jump audio plays multiple times if player hits space repeatedly while jumping
Audio for Oil in CZ0 state 1 still happening when state 1 in deactivated

notes.title: May 6 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305017/013fdacddf1c5791208d4211e8bb7c711e1743ed.png[/img]

[b]Waited long enough for an update?[/b]

Following a short hiatus, the Trash team is back together and sending out a big update to the Public Demo! After our little time away from the game we have spent the last months preparing a [b]Player Experience[/b] update based on all your wonderful feedback! So get 3 friends together and get ready for some Rubbish fun!  

[b]What is coming your way?[/b]

The May 6th [b]Taking Out The Trash Update[/b] isn’t a content update, rather a chance for us to add the things you asked for and make Trash easier to pick up and play! The update aims to improve player engagement, fix a long list of bugs, add player information & direction, include more UI systems and ultimately make the game easier to navigate and play. 

[b]Help us help YOU![/b]

We are extremely excited about the coming update and would love for you and your friends to play the demo together and give us even more feedback we can use to help shape the next stage of development. Give us the feedback to help us include more of what you like, and send what you don’t, to the scrap heap!

You can give Trash feedback on:

[url=https://twitter.com/15MinutesOfGame]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://forms.gle/DNLSHqA3FQ3BJQ4e6]Feedback Form[/url]
or in our community page!

As always we appreciate your support and hope you have a rubbish day!
